_comment: Tracking pin for the `git` package set: the head of the upstream default branch (`branch`), plus the archive hash of that commit and the hash of its pnpm dependency store. Unlike `versions`, this object is not append-only — .github/workflows/update-versions.yml rewrites it whenever the branch moves, so `dshPackageSets.git` always builds the newest commit CI has seen. Refresh it by hand with `./scripts/prefetch-dsh-version.sh --git > /tmp/git.json && python3 scripts/merge-git.py pkgs/git.json /tmp/git.json`.
